title: On Losing the whole crop in one night
subtitle: 成功成就 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）
meta: 主题语境：成功成就（做人与做事·成功与成就）　|　核心词汇：lose　|　正文 367 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 lose 的形式与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1981 the farmer ① lost the whole crop in one night for the whole place, and every child in the field said it was the first time anybody had done such a thing there. Three autumns on, people still spoke of how quietly it was done and of how, ever since, the farmer ② loses the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks without being asked. My mother said later that to ③ lose the whole crop in one night at all was the part nobody had expected.

By then somebody had surely ④ lost the whole crop in one night before — a line in the almanac for September 1975 hints at it — but nobody could name the person. ⑤ Losing the whole crop in one night for the whole place, the farmer said once, is nine parts patience and one part nerve; it is not the doing of it that people remember.

My uncle, who kept the basket at the far fence, meant the other thing entirely. He said that if anybody should ever ⑥ lose the case by one vote without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again. The rule the old hands handed down was plainer still: ⑦ Lose the case by one vote at once and never mention it again.

By 1988 the whole business had shrunk to half a line in the almanac, and a new child from the next field ⑧ loses the case by one vote for the whole place every autumn without once asking what it had cost the first time. My mother, who had watched all of it from the fence, said nothing at all; she simply ⑨ lost the whole crop in one night again when nobody else would.

⑩ To lose the whole crop in one night, my mother said in 1993, is not one thing but two: what you do and what the field remembers of it. She said the second half never grows lighter, and nowadays, whenever the field forgets, somebody loses the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks again and somebody must lose the whole crop in one night for the whole place all over again.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. v. 丢失（一般过去式 lost the whole crop in one night：1981 年农人头一回这样做，替所有人）
B. v. 丢失（一般现在 loses the whole crop in one night：自那以后成了老习惯，不必有人开口）
C. v. 丢失（不定式 to lose the whole crop in one night：文中两处，一是母亲说的“难就难在……”，一是结尾那句格言）
D. v. 丢失（过去完成时 had lost the whole crop in one night：1975 年九月的农事历上那行字之前就有人做过）
E. v. 丢失（动名词 losing the whole crop in one night 作主语：“九分耐心、一分胆气”那一句）
F. v. 输掉（lose the case by one vote：should ever 之后的原形，指万一真要去输掉以一票之差输了那场官司）
G. v. 输掉（lose the case by one vote：祈使句，转述老手们当年立下的那条规矩）
H. v. 丢失（后段两处：新来的孩子照例 loses the case by one vote，而母亲又一次 lost the whole crop in one night）

answers.why: lose 意为“丢失”，1981 年农人替所有人丢失一夜之间损失了整季庄稼，那是田垄里头一回有人肯这么做，故用一般过去式 lost。
lose 意为“丢失”，自那以后农人不图一句谢把这件事做了一遍又一遍，不必有人开口，故用一般现在 loses。
lose 意为“丢失”，母亲说的是“难就难在肯丢失一夜之间损失了整季庄稼”，此处为不定式 to lose the whole crop in one night。
lose 意为“丢失”，农事历里 九月 那行字说明早在 1988 年之前就有人丢失过，故用过去完成时 had lost。
lose 意为“丢失”，农人说“丢失一夜之间损失了整季庄稼这件事是九分耐心一分胆气”，此处 losing the whole crop in one night 作主语。
lose 意为“输掉”，叔叔说的是“万一真有人去输掉以一票之差输了那场官司”，should ever 之后用原形 lose the case by one vote。
lose 意为“输掉”，老手们留下的规矩是祈使句：立刻输掉以一票之差输了那场官司（lose the case by one vote at once），以后再也不要提起。
lose 意为“丢失”，新来的孩子每个秋天都照例输掉以一票之差输了那场官司，从不问头一回的代价，用一般现在 loses。
lose 意为“丢失”，母亲在无人肯做的时候又一次替所有人丢失一夜之间损失了整季庄稼，用一般过去式 lost 叙述。
lose 意为“丢失”，结尾那句是母亲 1993 年的话：要丢失一夜之间损失了整季庄稼，其实不是一件事，而是两件事——你做的那一件，和田垄记住的那一件。

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 lose 的 3 种不同形式（过去式、第三人称、-ing、不定式等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1981 the farmer lost the whole crop in one night for the whole place, and nobody in the field forgot it.
Even now the farmer loses the whole crop in one night without a word of thanks whenever the field asks.
Losing the whole crop in one night for the whole place, my mother used to say, is nine parts patience and one part nerve.
If anybody should ever lose the case by one vote without a word of thanks, nobody should do it twice or speak of it again.
A new child from the next field loses the case by one vote for the whole place every autumn, asking nothing about the past.
When nobody else would, my mother lost the whole crop in one night again, and the field remembered that half.
